hook: Eleven shortcuts to fly around Xcode.
hookText: Eleven shortcuts to fly around Xcode.

beats.say: The guide opens with Shift, Command, O: Open Quickly, which finds a file by name and even takes a line number when a bug report points to one.
beats.statLabel: practical navigation shortcuts in the guide

beats.say: Control, Command, Left and Right arrows move back and forward through your navigation history, so you can follow a chain of definitions and return.
Other picks include Control 6 for the document-items menu, Shift Command J to reveal a file in the navigator, and Option-click for Quick Help.
